annual.cash_basis: CashCashEquivalentsRestrictedCashAndRestrictedCashEquivalents (includes restricted cash — no separate tag; net debt understated)

ttm.shares_basis: duration-weighted average of the four quarterly diluted weighted-average counts (a fiscal-Q4 count derived as 4 x FY - the other three quarters)

dividends.frequency_basis: 3 quarterly DPS facts inside FY2025-12-31 (2025-01-01..2025-12-31) plus one payment carried only in the FY total; the per-share facts are filed per quarter — a payment cadence inside the quarter (a monthly payer) is not tagged
dividends.fy_label_basis: the year most of each fiscal year falls in — two fiscal years end in the same calendar year; join on period_end, not the label
dividends.flows_basis: sum of the four quarterly rows 2025-09-30..2026-06-30

share_issuance.basis: not filed for any of the four quarters

dividends.shareholder_yield_basis: dividends_paid (4/4 quarters filed) + buybacks (4/4 quarters filed) − share_issuance NOT INCLUDED (not filed for any of the four quarters); sum of the four quarterly rows 2025-09-30..2026-06-30

legs.share_issuance: not filed for any of the four quarters

net_buyback_yield.note: an upper bound — the issuance leg is filed for only some quarters or not at all

legs.share_issuance: not filed for any of the four quarters

shareholder_yield.note: an upper bound — the issuance leg is filed for only some quarters or not at all

net_buyback_yield.label: ≤ 2.22%
net_buyback_yield.note: share_issuance: not filed for any of the four quarters — no deduction made, so this yield is an upper bound

shareholder_yield.label: ≤ 4.23%
shareholder_yield.note: share_issuance: not filed for any of the four quarters — no deduction made, so this yield is an upper bound

notes: annual_dps labels: FY2016-12-31 here (period ended 2016-12-31) is labelled FY2016 in the annual / quarterly tables; FY2017-12-31 here (period ended 2017-12-31) is labelled FY2017 in the annual / quarterly tables; FY2018-12-31 here (period ended 2018-12-31) is labelled FY2018 in the annual / quarterly tables; FY2019-12-31 here (period ended 2019-12-31) is labelled FY2019 in the annual / quarterly tables; FY2020-12-31 here (period ended 2020-12-31) is labelled FY2020 in the annual / quarterly tables; FY2021-12-31 here (period ended 2021-12-31) is labelled FY2021 in the annual / quarterly tables; FY2022-12-31 here (period ended 2022-12-31) is labelled FY2022 in the annual / quarterly tables; FY2023-12-31 here (period ended 2023-12-31) is labelled FY2023 in the annual / quarterly tables; FY2024-12-31 here (period ended 2024-12-31) is labelled FY2024 in the annual / quarterly tables; FY2025-12-31 here (period ended 2025-12-31) is labelled FY2025 in the annual / quarterly tables — two fiscal years end in the same calendar year (a 53-week year or a fiscal-year-end change); join on period_end

dps_ttm: the latest four quarterly DPS facts are not consecutive quarters (182 days between 2025-09-30 and 2026-03-31) — FY2025-12-31 DPS 2.84 + the quarters since (2026-03-31: 0.75, 2026-06-30: 0.75) − the same quarters a year earlier (2025-03-31: 0.71, 2025-06-30: 0.71)
share_issuance_ttm: not all of the last four quarters have a filed share_issuance figure (missing 2025-09-30, 2025-12-31, 2026-03-31, 2026-06-30)
